Chapter 1432 - 10: Summoning The Future Self

Chapter 1432 - 10: Summoning the Future Self

"Something's wrong." Lin Yuan immediately grew alert.

The owner of the Time-Space Shop had repeatedly warned him that in the Wanwei space-time, the greatest danger was not from the Wanwei space-time itself.

Lord Wanwei harbored no significant malice toward future lords, and even though some tests might have been left behind, they generally wouldn't be life-threatening.

In Wanwei space-time, the real danger comes from other lords!

Strictly speaking, all lords who enter Wanwei space-time are competitors.

Slaying a lord, even if it's just the main combat body of the lord, yields far more benefits than exploring within Wanwei space-time.

"Could this lake be a trap?"

Lin Yuan gazed from afar at the azure lake, noticing the dark energy that flashed at the moment Tianshi vanished.

The entire lake was extremely integrated with Wanwei space-time, which was why Tianshi chose to approach the lake directly.

The crucial sites within Wanwei space-time all have similar energies, which are difficult for other lords to mimic.

Even Lin Yuan didn't initially have any doubts about the azure lake.

If it weren't for the anomaly at the moment Tianshi disappeared, these associations wouldn't have arisen.

"Hmm?"

Not only Lin Yuan, but some other lords also sensed something.

The dark energy flowing from the azure lake was incompatible with the lake itself.

"Let's see if Tianshi will emerge."

Lin Yuan carefully observed the azure lake.

Whether this is a trap depends on whether Tianshi can emerge and how he appears.

Soon.

More than a dozen breaths passed.

Then suddenly.

The previously calm azure lake began to boil abruptly.

Large swathes of azure lake water exploded, revealing infinite dark power.

"With just your power, you dare threaten me?"

A towering figure emanating a terrifying aura appeared, the surrounding space-time continuously evaporating; this imposing figure with gray curved horns was indeed Tianshi.

Tianshi forcibly tore himself from the azure lake, unleashing deeper levels of dark power, layer upon layer of dark fields stacked endlessly and mightily.

"Sneaky! Show yourselves!"

Tianshi roared, as he was accidentally pulled into the depths of the lake; three figures hiding in the darkness revealed themselves, demanding he hand over twenty million pounds of Time Sand?

In the past, Tianshi might have agreed, as the cost to forge his main combat body exceeded twenty million pounds of Time Sand.

However, before Wanwei space-time opened, Tianshi made a breakthrough, overcoming the second-to-last ordeal out of ten billion eight hundred thousand ordeals, and was just one ordeal away from reaching the Legendary Lord level.

And to ensure sufficient gains during this opening of Wanwei space-time, to prepare for the last ordeal of the ten billion eight hundred thousand ordeals.

Tianshi secretly brought in a main combat weapon.

With the current second-level ultimate power and that main combat weapon,

Tianshi considers himself the strongest below the Legendary Lord.

The dark power weapon wielded by those three dark figures can easily suppress lords who have only touched the threshold of legend, but to suppress Tianshi? It's not enough.

This is why Tianshi chose to resist directly.

If he knew he was not an opponent and had no hope, Tianshi would naturally make the most sensible choice.

Honestly handing over twenty million pounds of Time Sand.

But Tianshi has confidence in countering those three dark figures and certainly won't submit to this pressure.

...

"What, that lake is a trap?"

"I sensed something abnormal in Tianshi's aura when he entered."

Each Time Lord had an epiphany, simultaneously growing more shocked by Tianshi's power.

"Tianshi didn't go all out when facing us."

"Yes, the dark energy from the lake was enough to easily suppress us, yet Tianshi broke free, holding back; Tianshi certainly held back."

Many Time Lords looked serious, as they were all at the pinnacle of the second level, approaching the threshold of legacy, with keen vision. They immediately sensed the terrifying power of Tianshi.

That is true second-level ultimate power.

"So strong."

Lin Yuan also looked serious; compared to Tianshi now, even his true self is slightly weaker.

"Unless I create the second stance of the 'Innate Five Great' or truly step into the Time Lord level, I won't be a match for this Tianshi."

Lin Yuan thought inwardly; only these two areas of improvement could mean a transformation and qualitative change.

"I wonder how many ordeals Tianshi has overcome?"

Lin Yuan watched Tianshi standing in endless darkness.

First, it can be confirmed that Tianshi hasn't started the final stages of the three billion three hundred thousand ordeals.

'Infinite ordeals' are divided into three levels or stages—

Thirty-six billion two hundred thousand ordeals.

Ten billion eight hundred thousand ordeals.

Three billion three hundred thousand ordeals.

The three billion three hundred thousand ordeals are the final stage, and lords at this level are known as Legendary Lords.

Compared to the previous two levels, the means of Legendary Lords are more elusive.

Vast and expansive, Wanwei space-time provides unbounded ages for each Time Lord to explore, yet it was merely created by Lord Wanwei at the last moment after failing to break through the Fourteenth Rank as the Perfect Time Being.

Of course, Lord Wanwei's strength is extremely formidable even among the Legendary Lords.

But even the weakest of Legendary Lords has power surpassing the ultimate lords of the second level.

If Tianshi were truly a Legendary Lord, he wouldn't have bothered with the fight against more than a dozen other lords.
